title: 听力准备：安排与时长

cases.stem: When will they start their homework?
evidence: Leo: I walk the dog then. Could we start at half past five?
Mina: Fine. We can work for forty minutes and then take a break.
reasons: 五点是最初提议，后来改成五点半。
half past five 是五点半，不是四点半。

title: 听力准备：人物动机与故事顺序

cases.transcript:

Partner: Does that show she dislikes oranges?
Reader: No. Earlier she says they are her favourite fruit. Her friend has not eaten all day, so the choice shows concern.
Partner: We need both details to understand it.
cases.stem: Why does the girl give away the orange?
evidence: Reader: In my story, the girl gives away her last orange.
No. Earlier she says they are her favourite fruit.
Her friend has not eaten all day, so the choice shows concern.
reasons: 她先前说橙子是最喜欢的水果。
这是她最后一个橙子，不是还剩很多。
cases.evidenceReason: last orange说明付出，favourite fruit反对讨厌的猜测；朋友整天没吃饭解释送出的关心。

explanationSteps.text: 先核对先前的喜好：橙子是她最喜欢的水果。
explanationSteps.reason: earlier与favourite fruit否定她因为讨厌橙子才送出的猜测。

explanationSteps.text: 再接朋友的处境：整天没吃饭，所以她把最后一个橙子给了朋友。
explanationSteps.reason: 朋友的需要解释关心；last也排除她还剩很多的说法。
